posts.cooked:
Hello sir,

I am getting some error as shown in screenshots while trying to login to my VM. I was able to login before and attempted BPT1,2,3 as well. I tried changing my network connection. I also used both ubuntu and windows. I also generated new key pair to try with those, but nothing seems to work. The deadline for both BPT 3,4 are quite near. I request your urgent help in this.

Regards,
Devodita

I earnestly request for your help in this regard as soon as possible. The deadline of BPT 4 is tomorrow itself. Submitting the BPT4 is extremely crucial for my understanding of the subject, better preparation for OPPE and finally better grades. I had mailed IITM support a while back, they replied with “Please post the issue in discourse so that our TA will be guiding you in this regard.”
Hoping for your valuable guidance in this, sir. Please help
